jobPostingInfo.title: Senior SRE Engineer
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
What you will be doing:

  • Run the production systems behind Lumen's cloud services.
  • Build tooling in Go and Python for deployment and on-call.

What we need to see:

  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of experience running Kubernetes in production.

The base salary range is $148,000 - $287,500 USD.
